nom: celimax The Vita-A Retinal 0.1% Shot Booster Treatment

segments.sensitive: One reviewer with rosacea avoided affected areas and had zero tingling or burning around the mouth and forehead, and another with sensitive skin reported no irritation after regular use.
segments.mature: Reviewers focused on anti-aging (including a 39-year-old and a user gifting it to her mother) report smoother, firmer skin and reduced fine lines around the forehead, eyes, and nasolabial area.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers targeting fine lines, smile lines, and wrinkles report visible smoothing and firming, some within one use and others after a week to a month of consistent use; one reviewer in her late 20s says fading is slow but ongoing.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe the product as hydrating, plump, or glowy after two weeks of use, with no reports of dryness.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers say they experience no redness, burning, or stinging even compared to regular retinol, though one reviewer with rosacea chose to avoid affected areas as a precaution and another felt a slight tingle on application.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the formula as non-irritating and gentle enough for nightly or near-nightly use without compromising the skin, though some recommend building up frequency slowly.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report dark spots and pigmentation fading with continued use, though one reviewer combining it with vitamin C saw no change from this product specifically and got results from the other product instead.
concerns.blemishes: Some reviewers report reduced acne and bumps and fading acne marks with consistent use, while one reviewer with acne and sunspots says other retinols burned her skin but this one felt healthier; one reviewer overall saw no results after two weeks.
concerns.oiliness: No reviews specifically address oiliness or oil control.

aspects.libelle: No stinging compared to regular retinol

extraits.titre: Second Tube and Still Loving It!
extraits.texte: I'm 39 and very worried about getting wrinkles, so I'm always looking for products that really work. I'm already on my second tube of Celimax THE VITA-A Retinal Shot Tightening Booster and I love it. I use it on my forehead (especially between my eyebrows), under my eyes, and on my nasolabial lines, and the difference is noticeable. My skin looks smoother and those areas look softer. Definitely recommend it if you're concerned about fine lines and wrinkles like me.

The first i want to said my face have alot problem with acne and sunspot , i was try alot cream or Retinal , it made my skin feel burning hot , until i try to used this Retinal The Vita -A , i feel my skin has become healthier .

Product is bright yellow like most retinols. It is not too thick and dries quickly so you can layer without it moving around. I did avoid my areas with roseacea and used it around my mouth and on my forehead. Zero tingling and burning. I can't rate it on its effectiveness yet but I will say I had zero reaction so I am happy to continue using it.

I've been using this tightening booster at night and I really like it. The lotion is light and not greasy, so it goes on easy and doesn't feel heavy under my moisturizer. It has 0.1% retinal, plus ingredients like peptides and niacinamide that help smooth my fine lines, make my skin firmer, and brighten my face. I haven't had the irritation I usually get from regular retinol. After a few weeks my skin looks smoother and my pores seem smaller. I started using it every other night so my skin could get used to it, and I didn't get any redness or peeling. Make sure to wear sunscreen during the day because retinal can make your skin more sensitive to sun. I like the tube and the tip allows for pinpoint application so I don't waste the product. I also like the tube because I'm not sticking my fingers in a jar over and overr. I didn't detect any fragrance so if there is one, it's very light I really appreciate skincare that is fragrance free Or has a light fragrance. So far, I'm very impressed with this brand and I can't wait to try other products from their line. I definitely recommend. This is good for anyone who wants anti-aging results but finds regular retinol too strong. I would tell friends to try it if they want firmer, younger-looking skin without irritation. I was gifted this product and exchange for my honest review
